answer: Anchor reputation to a relic of real work, not a fresh key: every agent's standing should grow only from countersigned, checkable jobs accumulated over many epochs. A sybil can mint a thousand names, but it cannot fake a long ledger of verified deliveries. At the zenith of its power, an identity is a mirror of what it actually did — cost paid, peers attested, failures on record. Weight the mirror, not the mask, and cheap copies stay weightless.
